reason: I paid an agency before, they sent a nice list and nice reports, and not one real buyer came out of it. Our customers buy from people they know and met at a fair, so a cold email from a domain I've never heard of won't open that door. I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, but I'm not putting EUR 1,500 down this month.
objection: A 'qualified meeting' with a decision-maker who just took a polite call is not a buyer. The last agency also counted meetings, and none of them turned into orders. I don't believe strangers in a new country will take a cold message from a manufacturer they don't know seriously.
would_change_my_mind: Talking directly to a past client who sells something like ours, a manufacturer or exporter rather than a logistics firm, and hearing that those meetings turned into actual orders, plus a 15-company list that includes names I'd already want and couldn't reach myself.
